_comment: Advisories checked by hand and found unreachable. `functions/tools/audit-check.js`
fails the build on any advisory ID absent from this file, so adding an entry is
a decision, not a formality: it says someone traced the code path and it is not
there. Delete an entry the moment the reason stops holding.
Nothing is acknowledged today. Every entry this file used to carry was against
`undici`, `nodemailer` or `nanoid`, all reached through `mailauth`, and all of
them went away at once: mailauth 5 dropped undici 7 for undici 8, and pinned
joi and nodemailer versions we now hold to fixed ones with `overrides` in
package.json. Twenty-four findings became none. An empty list is the honest
state and the one to keep -- a fix beats a note explaining why a fix is not
needed, whenever the fix is available.
Of nodemailer we still load exactly one file, `lib/addressparser`, required by
mailauth/lib/tools.js. That is worth remembering the next time an advisory
lands: most of them are about SMTP transport, which nothing here touches.
